issue.title: Record title rename as a bob records operation

task_type_fields.proposal: Add a guarded bob operation that renames a record's title (and optionally its stem/file) from the Record Card: update frontmatter title, move the file when the stem changes, rewrite inbound links and the album [!records] index in one guarded write, and return inverse ops for Undo. The Record Card then offers a title stage. Bryan's bob-cli-ms note #3 moves the record title into the sheet header, which makes an in-card rename the natural next step.
task_type_fields.why_out_of_scope: bob-cli-ms settled that identity (parent, type, title, created) is not editable in v1 and lists title or stem rename as out of scope; it needs its own bob contract (file moves and link rewrites), not a Record Card value edit.

issue.creation_reason: The Record Card epic (bob-cli-ms, plan:202611/record_card.md Out of scope and land step 5) deferred title and stem rename to a v2 bob operation and asked its land agent to file it.
